Āka-p paṅku nūṟṟ’ irupatt’ iraṇṭukku I-śrī-villiputtūr nāṉk’ ellaikk’ uṭpaṭṭa naṉ-cey puṉ-cey karuñ-ceyum nattamum nattappārum tōṭṭamum tōṭṭa-k-kollaikaḷum kuḷamum kuḷa-p-parippum kiṇaṟukaḷum maṟṟum eṟppērpaṭṭa samasta-prāptikaḷum Iru-pattu muūṉṟ-āvatu nāḷ Eṇpatu varai-y-uḷḷa tēvatāṉam tiruviṭaiyāṭṭam paḷḷiccantam vaṭa-peruṅ-kōyil
Uṭaiyāṉukkum cūṭi-k kuṭutt-aruḷiya nācciyāṟkum periyāḻvāṟkum Ivv-ūr brāhmaṇar pakkal vilaiyum āññātiyuṅ koṇṭum dānam peṟṟum uṇṭāṉavai niīkki niīkki-y-uḷḷa cey puṉ-cey karuñ-cey nattamum nattappārum tōṭṭamum tōṭṭa-k-kollaikaḷum kuḷamum kuḷa-p-parippum kiṇaṟukaḷum maṟṟum eppērpaṭṭa samasta-prāptikaḷum muṉṉṉ-uṭaiyārum paḻam perumuḻavuim mutalil tavittu or-oru purav’ ākki vaṭa-peruṅ-kōyil-uṭaiyaṉukkum cūṭi-k kuṭutt-āruḷiya nācciyāṟkum periyāḻvāṟkum tiruviṭaiyāṭṭam ākki nam pōl co
